extension.description:
Stream audiobooks and podcasts from your Audiobookshelf server. Features include:
* Stream audiobooks (M4B, MP3, multi-file) * Stream podcasts with episode management * Progress sync with server * Download for offline playback * Chapter navigation * Resume playback * Search and add new podcasts * Find new episodes (from RSS) * API Key or Username/Password authentication
extension.news:
2026.11.17 - HTTPS servers, resume order - FIXED: Server address accepts a full URL (https, reverse proxy). - FIXED: Resume/chapter playback continues with the next track instead of restarting at track 1.
2026.7.28 - Live session sync - NEW: Position is now pushed to the open server session during online playback, so Audiobookshelf's "currently listening" and listening-time stats stay live. Final position is recorded when the session closes.
2026.7.27 - API call fixes - FIXED: Playback sessions use the real endpoints; they previously hit non-existent /api/session/local/... routes and never registered. - FIXED: Server-side podcast downloads no longer report a false error.
2026.7.26 - Chapters for single-file audiobooks - FIXED: Single-file audiobooks (e.g. M4B) with embedded chapters now open a chapter list. The library list API returns numChapters rather than a chapters array, so they were treated as having no chapters.
2026.7.24 - Separate libraries - CHANGED: Each Audiobookshelf library is now listed separately instead of merged into single Audiobooks/Podcasts folders. Enable "Group libraries by type" in settings for the old grouped view.
2026.7.10 - API key login - NEW: Optional API Key setting; when set it is used directly as the bearer token (no login/refresh) and overrides username/password.
2026.7.9 - Kodi repo compliance - Settings localized via strings.po; icon flattened (no transparency); LICENSE renamed to LICENSE.txt; fanart added.
